stem: An analyst reports a category's discount depth as the simple average of each order line's discount percentage. Why can this mislead?

options.text: Each line percentage includes VAT, which a simple average cannot remove
A 30% discount on a €25 cable counts as much as 30% off a €1,500 TV
Line discounts are stored in euros, so they cannot be shown as percentages
The average counts each order once, however many lines the order has
